t: Observing family purity draws holiness and peace into the home.
Innumerous letters from the Rebbe deal with Jewish family purity and marital life

. The following
presents only a small sample

“...Often such a situation arises due to undesirable intimacy when forbidden according to the Torah.
This is often caused by lack in knowledge of all the associated laws.
Therefore they, both the husband and wife, should clarify through an orthodox Rabbi knowledgable in
these matters all the details incumbent in observing these laws. And from now on to keep these laws,
keeping in mind that “there is nothing which stands in front of one’s will

“The channel to receive the Al-mighty’s blessing is behavior on a daily basis in
accordance with His will. This is besides the fact that these are incumbent upon us as G-dly
commandments. Each and every commandment is connected with a particular merit and force which it
evokes.

It is known that the blessing for fertility lies in keeping the laws of family purity. Therefore, it is fitting
for you to be exacting in your observance of these laws. Especially since during the course of time it is
possible that some of these laws became forgotten and it is important to review them. With blessings that
the Al-mighty fulfill all your wishes and waiting for good tidings

“In these situations it is correct to follow the advice of a physician
expert in this area, since we are to do whatever is possible according to nature…
However, and this is central, sometimes pregnancy is delayed WORD (mitakev) resulting from lacking
sufficient knowledge of the laws of purity.
Therefore, you should clarify through a rabbi who is very familiar with this area all necessary details.
Even though being raised with a religious education you have sufficient knowledge, nevertheless it is
worthwhile to clarify more, as it says, ‘there is no righteous person who may not have erred

“It is well known, and published, a particular letter from the Alter Rebbe. He wrote that

“Regarding your desire to conceive a son, I heard from my father in law something which
he received by tradition, based on the verse… “bmeh yizkeh naar et orcho…” Psalms 119:9, that the
merit to be blessed with a baby boy is through performing the mitzvah of hosting guests.
Of course, that is in addition to generally observing Torah and mitzvos. Though this may presently be
satisfactory, there is always room to add since this is connected to the Al-mighty who is infinite.
Regarding Torah study, clearly you should make sure to set aside time to study chasidus….

In response to your request for a blessing to have a son...
It is worthwhile for you to make additional efforts to increase love for a fellow Jew, for the Torah and
for G-d. It’s a known thing that the holy books write that giving ‘birth’ to this spiritual love is a catalyst
for one’s wife to give birth to a physical son. From this it’s understood that strengthening our inner love
through contemplating on G-d’s greatness (e.g. as the Rambam writes in the beginning of the second
chapter of Yesodei haTorah) this will bring longevity and health to one’s own sons for many years to
come. Therefore, you should decide, without the commitment of an oath, that until your wife gives birth
to a son you will give a few coins to charity before the morning prayers. It is best if this charity is
directed to helping feed students who have little financial means

“The Torah directive is well known, that although the Almighty is the ruler and
creator, nonetheless we are to make efforts in the physical realm as well. As the sages said, ‘the Torah
empowered physicians to heal. Therefore, you and your husband should undergo another medical
assessment through a physician who is expert in this field, and follow his advice.
Understandably, together with the above you should both add to Torah observance, particularly family
purity, modesty, giving charity and praying to He who gave the Torah to fulfil this most worthy desire

, purity and immersion, given to the Jewish woman, holiness and
purity is brought into the family life.
Living in accordance with the laws of family purity a husband and wife merit happy, healthy
children—healthy in body and soul, following the Torah’s ways, bringing true joy and pride to their
parents

Regarding spreading observance of family purity, please keep this in mind. Imagine that
the Almighty gave you the opportunity to save an entire city of Jews from destruction, G-d forbid. Surely
you would jump at the chance to do so, and be grateful for the enormous merit which had befallen you.
Promoting observance of these laws is this, and much more. It is literally saving lives
It is the responsibility of all

women to lead the way
strengthening everything related to Torah and

in general, and specifically observance of family

“...The Exodus from Egypt is the model for the coming redemption which is based on it. Regarding
the Exodus it is stated, ‘In the merit of the righteous women in that generation the entire Jewish nation
was redeemed

.’ So too is the coming redemption dependent on the commandments of the Jewish
women.
These three main commandments were given specifically to Jewish women—

food), and family purity.
These are all connected to basic human needs, and are conceptually connected also to the G-dly

service of non-Jews as far as their mission to “habitate” the world is concerned: Light, food and family
life.
The Jewish woman’s job, however, is to accomplish these three

in accordance with Jewish
directives. Candle lighting is connected with

food
and family life to the laws of purity.
This is in preparation for that time when the physical world itself becomes purified and ‘All flesh will
see that all is from His mouth
